title: UO+ shared settings: default off, staged edits, persistence and controller scrolling

steps.say: Set GUO_UOPLUS_PROOF to a private evidence folder before this run. The native panel uses an unsaved fixture profile.

do.text: Checks old/new profile defaults, independent flag/density JSON round trips, zero/clamps, build availability, water prerequisites, spell-only admission and cleanup without affecting generic hooks, staged edits, Apply/Defaults/Cancel, controller focus and scroll-to-bottom. Captures panel screenshots. Live-world sway is covered by client/sway.md.
